crossRefs.note: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.
Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?

translations.web: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.
translations.bsb: He made a horn at each of its four corners, so that the horns and altar were of one piece, and he overlaid the altar with bronze.
translations.kjv: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.
translations.asv: And he made the horns thereof upon the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of one piece with it: and he overlaid it with brass.
